summary: design-director checked in 1 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Preserve containment while delivery is saturated at 10/10. Do not create duplicate work. After CTO releases one slot with validation evidence, execute the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as the highest-value reversible design action. Scope: homepage/highest-intent merchandising surface only; improve CTA hierarchy, adjacent affiliate disclosure placement, keyboard focus, contrast, tap targets, and responsive spacing without changing destinations, adding tracking, dependencies, or data collection. Preview acceptance: unchanged destinations; visible CTA hierarchy at mobile and desktop widths; disclosure adjacent to affected links; WCAG-focused keyboard, focus, contrast, and target-size checks pass; existing links and smoke/build checks pass. Test: deterministic component/site tests, build, link validation, smoke, keyboard navigation, responsive screenshots, and accessibility scan. Metric: registered affiliate clicks versus the existing 61-click site baseline; measure for 14 days or 100 relevant impressions/clicks. Conversion, revenue, ROI, and causal lift remain unclaimed. Rollback: revert the single isolated diff if any validation gate fails or if material regressions appear.
